title: Research scope-contract hardening: stop_conditions / assumptions / decision_context first-class + bounded-termination control (control 19)
objective: Close the SKILL<->schema asymmetry in the frozen badf-research contract: the root skill instructs resolving stop conditions but the record schema carries no first-class stop_conditions, assumptions, or decision_context. Add them extend-only as required fields, add a deterministic control 19 (a material research run declares bounded, non-empty stop_conditions; assumptions distinct from evidence; decision_context names the decision served), update the three examples and align the docs. badf-research stays DESIGNED.
business_value: Makes the bounded research scope machine-readable, so a research run cannot be recorded without declaring when it stops, what it assumes (distinct from what it observed), and which decision it serves -- reinforcing the RESEARCH != DECISION topology without granting implementation authority.
in_scope: schemas/research-record.schema.json: add stop_conditions, assumptions, decision_context (required, extend-only)
validate_research_record: control 19 -- stop_conditions non-empty; each assumption a non-empty string; decision_context.decision_question present
examples/research-record.json, research-record-challenged.json, research-record-repo.json updated to carry the three fields
tests/test_badf_research.py failing-first + mutation; own G07 self-dossier; doctrine note
out_of_scope: control 6 (source-digest freshness -- needs a source fetch)
the remaining 8 P0 research subskills -- one WP each
#77's canonical reference split (a docs refactor, deferrable)
any change to evidence_digest (the new fields are framing, not evidence)
any move of badf-research off DESIGNED; external #69/#77 branches/issues untouched
acceptance_criteria: the three shipped examples pass `research` with the new fields present
a record with absent or empty stop_conditions is refused naming it
a record whose assumptions contains an empty string is refused
a record with no decision_context.decision_question is refused
the new fields are absent from the evidence_digest computation (control 17 unchanged: digest stable when only framing changes)
acceptance.md documents control 19; SKILL.md references the three first-class fields
mutation kills; compose green both shapes; PyYAML-absent suite green

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design; the next WP reconciles it. Extend-only hardening of the frozen contract through a governed WP (not a reopen of #50). Brings research controls to 17 of 19; control 6 (freshness) still open. Overlaps external #69/#77 -- built fresh under my own issue #79, their work untouched.
